evidence: There is growing evidence that regular review improves retention.

analyze: The report analyzes the causes of traffic congestion in major cities.

academic: The journal publishes academic research on rural migration.

balance sheet: The board reviewed the balance sheet at the end of the quarter.

board meeting: The minutes of the board meeting will be sent tomorrow.

customer service: Our customer service team replies within twenty-four hours.

sales target: The team exceeded its quarterly sales target.

take care of: Who will take care of customer complaints during the holiday?
